# Operator maintained exceptions for the Iran-only access filter.
#
# Every CIDR here is merged on top of app/data/iran_ip_ranges.txt, and — unlike
# that generated file — is never rewritten by the "refresh list" action or by
# scripts/refresh_iran_ip_ranges.py, so an exception survives a list refresh.
#
# One CIDR per line, '#' starts a comment.  Keep the list short: every entry is
# a range of non-Iranian addresses that may use the system.  The settings card
# reports how many are in force (status key: extra_ranges).
#
# 31.171.96.0/21 — Delta Telecom Ltd (AZ, AS29049; RIPE "DeltaTelecom").
#   Iranian users whose ISP or office network egresses through this Azerbaijani
#   shared NAT pool were answered with the "foreign IP / VPN" page although they
#   run no VPN: several neighbouring addresses of the same /24 (.25, .29, .216)
#   plus 31.171.101.199 were blocked on their way to /login on 2026-09-29 (see
#   dbo.audit_logs, action='iran_only_blocked').  A registry country says where
#   the space is registered, not where the visitor is sitting.
#   Delete this line once those users have a domestic egress again.
31.171.96.0/21
